name: ioctl_ns
synopsis: int new_fd = ioctl(int fd, unsigned long op);
description: The ioctl() system call provides operations for discovering Linux namespace relationships, such as obtaining file descriptors for owning or parent namespaces, determining namespace types, and getting owner UIDs.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor referring to a /proc/pid/ns/* file

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: The ioctl request code, such as NS_GET_USERNS or NS_GET_PARENT

parameters.name: arg
parameters.description: Optional argument, e.g., a pointer for NS_GET_OWNER_UID

return_value.success: Returns a new file descriptor for NS_GET_USERNS and NS_GET_PARENT, the namespace type for NS_GET_NSTYPE, or 0 for NS_GET_OWNER_UID on success
return_value.failure: Returns -1 and sets errno on error

errors.description: The requested namespace is outside of the caller’s namespace scope
The operation is not supported or fd does not refer to a /proc/pid/ns/* file
fd refers to a nonhierarchical namespace or is invalid for the operation
